entities.name: Release assistance indication
entities.description: An optional information element that the UE may include to inform the network about expected data transmission patterns.

entities.name: No further uplink and downlink data expected
entities.description: Condition indicating that no additional uplink or downlink data transmission is expected after the current transmission.

entities.name: Single downlink data transmission expected
entities.description: Condition indicating that only one downlink data transmission (e.g., acknowledgement) and no further uplink data transmission is expected.

relations.description: The release assistance indication IE can signal the condition of no further data transmission expected.
The release assistance indication IE can signal the condition of only a single downlink transmission expected.
